infrastructureDiscrepancyFinding: This task's brief assumed the production Render service ('tina-backend') tracks the main branch and requires a merge/cherry-pick before activation. Direct inspection of the Render API and the live server's own /debug/db-identity endpoint shows tina-backend is configured with branch=feature/source-availability-engine-v1 and autoDeploy=yes, has been deploying that branch continuously since 2026-07-09 (deploy history shows a branch switch away from main sometime between 2026-06-17 and 2026-07-09; main-only commits df8a0ce/01cfba6/9672983 were the last main-sourced deploys), and its latest live deploy is commit 7b892ed -- the exact commit whose runtime is identical to the verified 09ZB staging PASS commit 52e133f (7b892ed only adds documentation). TINA_ENABLE_CONTROLLED_LOA_ASK_GATE is already TRUE on this service. User confirmed this configuration (tina-backend deploying the feature branch directly, mirroring staging) is the intentional current release process, not accidental drift. Consequently, main is not the deploy source for production and no merge/cherry-pick/fast-forward strategy is applicable to actual activation.

mainOnlyCommits: df8a0ce PATCH-017 add route timeout preservation and latency instrumentation
branchComparison.reason: main has 3 independent commits not present on feature, and feature has 286 commits not on main including a near-total architecture rewrite (security/, tax-engines/, memory-boundaries/, retrieval/authority engines); a full merge would introduce a vast amount of unrelated, unreviewed runtime beyond the approved controlled-LOA scope, and literal cherry-pick of the 09X-09ZI commits onto main would fail due to massive surrounding-code drift. This comparison is retained for audit purposes but is not the operative deployment path, since production (tina-backend) does not deploy from main.

releaseStrategy: No branch merge, cherry-pick, or fast-forward is required or recommended. The verified release candidate (commit 7b892ed, runtime-identical to 52e133f) is already the live deployment on the production-facing service tina-backend via its existing branch=feature/source-availability-engine-v1 / autoDeploy=yes configuration, confirmed as the intentional current release process. 'Activation' in this context consists of confirming the already-deployed commit and already-enabled feature flag are correct and match staging evidence exactly (done), not performing a new deploy or flag change.
